metadata.tags: original preschool song at 72 BPM in a bright major key, warm natural adult female lead vocal, clear English diction, stable pitch, minimal vibrato, friendly moderate phrase speed, easy for ages two to six to imitate, Slow, warm lullaby. Soft acoustic guitar or celesta, brushed light percussion or none at all, no build, no key change, no big finish. It should be quieter at the end than at the start., female vocals
metadata.prompt:
[Verse 1]
Five little stars are shining bright,
Peeking through my window light.
Coco counts them, one by one,
Softly now the day is done.

[Chorus]
Twinkle, twinkle, close your eyes,
Sleepy stars in sleepy skies.
Count them with me, drift away,
Goodnight, goodnight, till a brand new day.

[Verse 2]
Four little stars, then three, then two,
One last star is watching you.
Coco yawns and snuggles deep,
Warm and cosy, off to sleep.

[Outro]
Goodnight, goodnight, little bear,
Goodnight, goodnight, everywhere.
